title: bundle
description: A Bundled Set of Questions (NIH CDE Repository Guide): 'a group of CDEs that lose meaning/validity if extracted and used individually. Most validated, standardized instruments are bundles' (e.g. PHQ-9, AUDIT; or a value + its unit). A bundle is INDIVISIBLE — its member CDEs are used as a set. Sourced from NLM Forms flagged isBundle=true (and from CDEs' partOfBundles). Distinct from a `form`, which is an assembly instrument that may reuse bundles. Membership is a direct cde -> bundle PART_OF relationship, in question order. The bundle's taxonomy placement AND its vetted recommendation `tier` live in `bundle_classification` (one row per bundle x steward x context) — the tier is set once, on the bundle, and forms that reuse the bundle do not re-vet it.

bundle_key.description: The bundle's identity. For NLM bundles this is 'nlm:<tinyId>' (globally unique). The human title lives in `bundle_name`.

bundle_name.description: Human-readable bundle title — the instrument name for a standardized instrument (e.g. 'PHQ-9'), else a descriptive name (NIH Guide: 'If the bundle is a standardized instrument, use the instrument name').

steward_org.description: The steward org that owns the bundle (the authoritative owner, e.g. NINDS). Same concept as cde.steward_org; distinct from a classification edge's steward_org (the classifying authority in bundle_classification).

steward_code.description: The steward's OWN identifier for the bundle, when recorded (cross-source merge key, mirroring form.steward_code). Null when absent.

member_cde_keys.description: Member cde_keys in question order (NLM 'Order of Question'). An ordering hint for display; membership itself is the cde -> bundle PART_OF edges.

references.description: Published evidence on the validity/reliability of the bundle in target populations (DOIs / PubMed IDs / stable identifiers). Required for bundles per the NIH Guide; captured when the source provides it.

nlm_identifier.description: Upstream bundle identifier (NLM form tinyId of the isBundle form).

nlm_view_url.description: Canonical NLM CDE Repository form view page for the bundle.

registration_status.description: NLM/ISO-11179 administered-item lifecycle state of the bundle.

nih_endorsed.description: NIH-Endorsed governance flag (NLM `nihEndorsed`). Same flag as cde.nih_endorsed / form.nih_endorsed.

copyright_status.description: Upstream copyright / redistribution status (NLM `copyrightStatus`, e.g. 'Public domain, free to use'). Same concept as cde.copyright_status.

num_questions.description: Number of questions (CDEs) in the bundle.

source_version.description: The upstream source's own version string, captured verbatim (e.g. NLM/caDSR '3.1'). Same concept as cde.source_version.
